description: Write comprehensive unit tests for the CloakBrowser stealth browser integration covering config, base_crawler.launch_browser_stealth(), and platform core.py stealth branches
steps: Create tests/test_stealth_browser.py with the following test classes:
1. TestStealthBrowserConfig - Test config/base_config.py stealth settings:
- Verify ENABLE_STEALTH_BROWSER exists and defaults to False
- Verify STEALTH_HUMANIZE exists and defaults to True
- Verify STEALTH_HUMAN_PRESET exists and defaults to 'default'
2. TestLaunchBrowserStealth - Test base/base_crawler.py AbstractCrawler.launch_browser_stealth():
- Create a concrete subclass of AbstractCrawler for testing (implement abstract methods with pass/mock)

- Test when SAVE_LOGIN_STATE=True: mock cloakbrowser.launch_persistent_context_async, verify it is called with correct params (user_data_dir containing platform name, headless, proxy, user_agent, viewport={width:1920,height:1080}, humanize from config, human_preset from config)

- Test when SAVE_LOGIN_STATE=False: mock cloakbrowser.launch_context_async, verify it is called with correct params (headless, proxy, user_agent, viewport={width:1920,height:1080}, humanize from config, human_preset from config)
- Test proxy=None case: verify None is passed through to the CloakBrowser function
- Test user_agent=None case: verify None is passed through
- Test with custom proxy dict like {'server': 'http://proxy:8080'}: verify dict passes through
- Test headless=True and headless=False: verify headless parameter passes correctly
- Test with STEALTH_HUMANIZE=False and STEALTH_HUMAN_PRESET='careful': verify these config values are passed
- Verify returned browser_context is the mock object from CloakBrowser call
3. TestPlatformStealthBranch - Test stealth branching in platform crawlers (test XHS, Douyin, Bilibili as representatives):
- For each platform crawler, test when ENABLE_STEALTH_BROWSER=True: verify launch_browser_stealth is called and self.browser_context is set to its return value
- Test when ENABLE_STEALTH_BROWSER=False and ENABLE_CDP_MODE=True: verify launch_browser_with_cdp is called (playwright branch)
- Test when both ENABLE_STEALTH_BROWSER=False and ENABLE_CDP_MODE=False: verify standard launch_browser is called
- Mock all downstream calls (login, client creation, search/detail methods) to prevent actual execution past browser launch
4. TestEdgeCases - Boundary/edge cases:
- Test launch_browser_stealth with empty string user_agent
- Test the user_data_dir path construction (ensure it includes config.PLATFORM correctly)
All tests use:
- pytest.mark.asyncio for async tests
- unittest.mock.patch and unittest.mock.AsyncMock for mocking cloakbrowser functions
- @patch('config.ATTRIBUTE', value) for config overrides
acceptance_criteria: All tests pass when running: pytest tests/test_stealth_browser.py -v
Coverage of base/base_crawler.py launch_browser_stealth() method is >= 90%
Coverage of stealth-related config variables is 100%
Tests mock CloakBrowser functions - no real browser is launched
Tests verify correct parameter passing (proxy, user_agent, headless, humanize, human_preset, viewport)
Tests cover both SAVE_LOGIN_STATE=True and False branches
verification: Confirm all tests pass (no FAILED or ERROR)
Confirm coverage of launch_browser_stealth lines is >= 90%
findings: Patching cloakbrowser functions requires patching at 'cloakbrowser.launch_context_async' (not 'base.base_crawler.launch_context_async') because the import is local inside the function body. Platform stealth branch tests need StopAsyncIteration side_effect on browser_context.new_page() to prevent downstream code from running indefinitely. Pre-existing test_create_excel_store failure in test_store_factory.py is unrelated.
